definitions.explanation: A condition in which the heart cannot pump blood effectively enough to meet the body's needs. A serious illness and a frequent cause of death listed in news reports and obituaries.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{心不全|しんふぜん}で{亡|な}くなった。
examples.english: My grandfather died of heart failure.

examples.japanese: {急性|きゅうせい}{心不全|しんふぜん}で{入院|にゅういん}した。
examples.english: He was hospitalized with acute heart failure.

examples.japanese: {慢性|まんせい}{心不全|しんふぜん}の{患者|かんじゃ}は{塩分|えんぶん}{摂取|せっしゅ}を{制限|せいげん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Patients with chronic heart failure need to restrict their salt intake.

notes:
Compound of {心|しん} (heart) + {不全|ふぜん} (insufficiency/failure of an organ). The {不全|ふぜん} element appears in many medical condition names: {腎|じん}{不全|ふぜん} (kidney failure), {呼吸|こきゅう}{不全|ふぜん} (respiratory failure).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急性|きゅうせい}{心不全|しんふぜん}: acute heart failure
- {慢性|まんせい}{心不全|しんふぜん}: chronic heart failure
- {心不全|しんふぜん}で{亡|な}くなる: to die of heart failure
- {心不全|しんふぜん}を{起|お}こす: to develop heart failure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}: myocardial infarction; heart attack — a specific event (blocked artery), often a cause of heart failure
- {心臓|しんぞう}{病|びょう}: heart disease — broad umbrella term that includes heart failure
